adaptation: Original Meta AstryX navigation/menu/data-display components with explicitly host-authored minimal local fixtures. Not an official complete business app. Collapsible original controlled expansion; DropdownMenu original selection plus actual MoreMenu icon-trigger wrapper shown in same entry, not counted separately; ContextMenu original right-click local selection; Tabs original TabList local panel value; Stepper bounded local steps; List original selectable rows; MetadataList original static labelled sample facts; Token original remove plus host restore. All actions affect local illustrative state only, no network, files, clipboard, service commands or navigation. Same originalcore/neutraltheme/StyleX geometry, per-entry independent IIFE. Fixed source documentation0.7.12 versus installedcore/theme/build0.7.11 compatibility runtime disclosed. Hidden unmount resets localfixture; visible mounts fresh; exit/error cleans owned resources. Actual550compose and loader/cache/release plus each key interaction/exit, shared early/late/reduced under JSDOM. Pointer coordinates for contextmenu are synthetic event positions, not native placement geometry/visual acceptance. StyleX CSS parser warnings recorded separately. RootMIT and all actual emitteddependency full licenses; prior core/StyleX missing-file official supplements clearly identified. MoreMenu reviewed source only forwards configured icon-only props to DropdownMenu; oneentrycoversboth, no alias-based count increase.
